downstack-under-pressure.roadmap_item: 1 — Pre-register `downstack rate under pressure` BEFORE the next session is recorded
downstack-under-pressure.hypothesis: paired AUC, winner vs loser, of rows cleared per piece over locks whose PRE-lock board carries at least one garbage row, over the verified prefix; one-sided, winner higher
unblinding: CLAUDE.md publishes the UNCONDITIONAL per-piece DS paired AUC for both banked sessions (08-09: 66.0, 08-14: 70.2). That is not the registered estimand — the registered one conditions on garbage being on the pre-lock board — but the two are correlated, so the bank is partially unblinded and the confirmatory test must be reported as such.

deviations.what: The estimand is pinned to the CURRENT instrument — runCaseOracle over the post-hoisted-DAS verified prefix — rather than to the instrument that existed at registration. 08-09 and 08-14 stay in the confirmatory bank.
deviations.why: Between registration (2026-08-07) and this pin the verified prefix grew ~31% (hoisted-DAS fix c9f3065, 2026-08-11) and the board source moved to runCaseOracle (a38ccc1, 2026-08-12). board-metrics.ts itself was last touched 2026-08-06 (f5ee923) and still imports the hand-port runCase, so 'as computed today' named an instrument the rest of the repo has demoted. Both changes were made for documented drift reasons, blind to this hypothesis, and the estimand has never been computed on the banked sessions. Estimand, unit, direction, test, threshold and controls are unchanged, so this is a deviation in instrument, not a new hypothesis.
